availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Petalburg Woods (Heracross, Kartana) is on the C05 main path long before Mauville; Heracronite's stone window is 14 and the Mega Ring is earned from Steven after Brawly (C13).
plan: Dillon is Garganacl + Baxcalibur with an Avalugg/Arboliva back half. The dossier crack asks for special pressure, denying recovery and setup, removing Loaded Dice, and attacking around Wide Guard. Fighting answers the whole roster: 4x into Rock/Steel Garganacl, 2x into Ice Baxcalibur and Avalugg, 2x into Normal-typed Arboliva. Mega Heracross's Skill Link multi-hits also ignore Focus-Sash-style chip and punish Iron Defense slowly, while Kartana's Sacred Sword ignores Iron Defense outright and Incineroar's Knock Off removes Loaded Dice and Leftovers. Every one of those is single-target, so Avalugg's Wide Guard has nothing to block.
